title: Audit trail, API keys and service authentication
objective: Append-only audit events (actor, action, target, org, request id, safe metadata) for security-sensitive actions including denied escalations; API keys (prefix+id+secret, HMAC hash, scopes, expiry, last-used, revocation, rotation, shown once); machine-to-machine JWT bearer auth via JWKS distinct from human users.
acceptance_criteria: Audit rows cannot be updated or deleted (DB trigger test); no secrets in metadata (test)
API key tests: shown once, wrong secret, revoked, expired, scope denied, rotation
Service JWT tests: wrong audience/issuer/expired rejected; service principal is not a user
